dream: I dreamt my teeth were crumbling and falling out into my hands.
A snake was chasing me through my childhood house.
I was falling from a great height and woke before I hit the ground.
I was flying over a river, completely calm.
My mother appeared and told me she had died, and I felt calm.
I was drowning in deep dark water and could not reach the surface.
I turned up to school for a test having never studied.
I was naked in the middle of a crowded street and nobody noticed.
My house caught fire and I could not get everyone out.
I was being chased and my legs would not move, so I could not run.
I found a baby I did not know I had and forgot to feed it.
My hair was falling out in handfuls when I brushed it.
I was driving a carriage and it ran away from me on a hill.
I dreamt of a wedding where the bride never arrived.
I kept trying to phone someone but the number never connected.
A large black dog followed me and would not leave.
I was lost on a long journey through a strange city.
I saw my dead grandfather sitting at the kitchen table.
